post_meta.author: u/2200milesofsnacks
post_meta.title: Muir Pass slog
post_meta.text: Muir was fine, just endless. Snow for like 4 miles on each side of the hut, sun cups the whole way. No spikes needed by afternoon, it is so soft you just posthole. Evolution Creek was the real story, we crossed at the meadow alternate and it was still waist deep at 8am.

post_meta.title: Mather and Muir mid July
post_meta.text: Mather 7/13: south ramp is 90 percent melted, a switchbacking dirt path with two short snow crossings, no traction. Muir 7/15: couple miles of soft snow around the hut, flat, tedious, safe. Palisade Creek crossing knee high. The season flipped in two weeks.
